purpose: Separate 64/128 evolution comparison of the unchanged late-growth initial field through t=.10
reference_rule: Reuse the verified 64-grid trajectory; evolve the 128-grid field from the same initial coefficients at time zero. Do not pad an evolved coarse state or optimize on these holdouts.

additional_sampling.scope: Endpoint samples of the same evolved fields; these do not add evolution modes or certify spatial maxima between sample points.

validation_scope: Use the existing verified FFTW continuation executable and independently crosscheck each saved critical budget with NumPy FFTs. The prior complete radix2/FFTW trajectory and smaller-step checks are at N=64; this campaign does not claim a new full N=128 independent or timestep trajectory.
stop_rule: Stop each trajectory on its existing per-step cutoff or invariant failure. A failed spatial comparison is reported as a resolution limit. This bounded experiment ends at grid 128 and time .10.
interpretation: Empirical finite-amplification evidence, not a Fourier-tail certificate or a proof or disproof of regularity.
